text: 7月17日至20日，2026世界人工智能大会暨人工智能全球治理高级别会议（WAIC 2026）在上海世博、张江、西岸三地同步举行。乐奇Rokid携首款智能眼镜原生操作系统YodaOS及新一代AR空间计算设备亮相西岸国际会展中心，继今年6月底发布后，完成两大核心产品的全球首次展会首秀。（上证报）
text_en: From July 17 to 20, the 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference and High-Level Meeting on Global AI Governance (WAIC 2026) was held simultaneously across Shanghai's Expo, Zhangjiang, and West Bund venues. Leqi Rokid showcased its first native operating system for smart glasses, YodaOS, and the next-generation AR spatial computing device at the West Bund International Convention Center, marking the global debut of both core products since their end-of-June release. (Shanghai Securities News)
